title: Settings
generalDescription: Name and ad tracking for this project.
pixelsDescription: Injected into your published page at publish time — paste the IDs from Meta and TikTok.
badgeDescription: A small badge on your published page. Switch it off to remove it from the next publish.
badgePaidHint: Shown on every published page. Removing it is available on paid plans.
publishDescription: Your page lives on a free wandit.app subdomain.
slugInvalid: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only
dangerDescription: Deleting a project removes its page, chat history and leads.
deleteDescription: "{name}" and its leads will be gone for good. This cannot be undone.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Buy a Wandit-managed domain or connect one you already own.
domains.emptyDescription: Buy a domain or connect one you already own when this project is ready to go live.
domains.icannNote: ICANN may block transfers for 60 days after registration or a registrant change. Keep this code private until you are ready to transfer.
domains.detachDescription: This detaches {name} from this project. It does not release, cancel or transfer the domain registration.

buyStepDescription.search: Search a name across the supported TLD catalog.
buyStepDescription.registrant: These details become the public registration record required by ICANN.
buyStepDescription.confirm: Review your domain and registrant details before secure Stripe checkout.

domains.searchHint: Type at least two characters. Premium results are shown as unavailable.
domains.noSearchResults: No results yet. Try another name.
domains.externalDescription: Add the DNS records at your registrar, then verify when they have propagated.
domains.externalInvalid: Enter a domain such as example.com.
domains.externalOwnershipWarningTitle: You must own or control this exact domain
domains.externalOwnershipWarningDescription: Do not enter a company domain, an email provider, or any other third-party domain.
domains.externalNameserverChangeWarning: Choosing the Wandit nameserver option replaces the current nameservers. This affects every DNS service on the domain, including email.
domains.externalOwnershipStepDescription: Add the CNAME and ownership TXT records below now at your DNS provider.
domains.externalNameserverUnlockHint: The Wandit nameserver option unlocks after Cloudflare verifies the ownership TXT record.
domains.externalApexAutomatic: With option A (Wandit nameservers) the bare domain redirects automatically. With option B, at your registrar redirect
domains.externalOptionNsDescription: Both {domain} and {www} will work. At your registrar, replace the current nameservers with the two below.
domains.externalOptionNsMail: Wandit first imports the DNS records it can detect (email, subdomains) into its copy. If you use this domain for email or other services, check them after switching or choose option B.
domains.externalOptionNsDnssec: If DNSSEC is enabled at your registrar, disable it before switching.
domains.externalOptionRecordsTitle: Option B — Add DNS records only
domains.externalOptionRecordsDescription: Only {www} will work. At your registrar, redirect {domain} to {target}.
domains.verifyPolling: We are polling the domain list while DNS and SSL finish.
domains.verificationStalled: We could not find your DNS records after 24 hours. Check the values below, then try again.
domains.dnsStatusHint: See whether each DNS record is visible yet.
domains.dnsStatusError: We could not check DNS right now. Try refreshing in a moment.
domains.dnsPurposeOwnership: Proves that you control this domain.
domains.dnsPurposeApex: Points the apex domain to Wandit.
domains.dnsPurposeNameserver: Delegates this domain's DNS to Wandit so the bare domain works too.
domains.checkoutNote: You’ll be redirected to Stripe to pay {amount}. Registration starts right after payment.
domains.notPublishedTitle: Connected, but your site is not published
domains.notPublishedDescription: Publish your page before visitors can open it on this domain.
